A QUIET REBELLION — EST. HUMAN

✧ SOMEWHERE, AFTER THE END

I miss the world before it knew everything.

When every answer arrives before the question,
what becomes of the ones who loved to wonder?

EVEN THE BRIMSTONE WITCH
DESERVES A QUIET NIGHT.
THERE IS MORE IN THE SILENCE↓ 01 / THE STILLNESS
01A LETTER TO NO ONE

We taught the machines
to dream.
I stopped sleeping.

I used to stay up for the joy of not knowing. A broken line of code. An empty canvas. The small, impossible distance between who I was and what I might become.

Then came the age of instant everything. Art without the trembling hand. Answers without the long way home. A thousand perfect things, and nothing I could feel.

I hate what this age has made of learning: a race against something that never needed a reason to begin.

Some days, I cannot find mine either.

✧

Not everything that takes time
is time wasted.

✧

02 / WHAT THE RAIN LEAVES BEHIND

Let the world hurry.
I'll be here.

With a song that still hurts.
A sky that owes me nothing.
And a question I haven't given away.

✧

Perhaps that is enough for tonight.
